note: Sample charts for trying ManiaFlow without a beatmap of your own. They are generated patterns, not real songs, and they carry no audio — a preview runs on ManiaFlow's own clock. Every one of them parses to exactly the same notes as Ashtonk!mania's own parser.

charts.title: Neon Drift
charts.summary: An everyday stream chart: 1/2 and 1/4 taps, a few chords and short holds. Good first look at the Practice Studio.

charts.title: Velocity Study
charts.summary: Three BPM sections and five scroll-velocity changes, built to exercise the Timing Lab's scroll and beat-snap analysis.

charts.title: Hold Patterns
charts.summary: Long notes stacked, staggered and layered across every lane, for studying hold duration and release timing.
